reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Trevor McFedries, the founder of technology startup Brud and the creator of virtual pop star Miquela.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Trevor McFedries, the founder of technology startup Brud and the creator of virtual pop star Miquela. Trevor’s background is fascinating - he worked as a DJ and producer, toured with Katy Perry, worked at Spotify. In our conversation, we discuss the music-industrial complex, the creation of Miquela, and what Web 3.0 will mean for creators and builders in the future.
